summary:
Root-caused the bench "daemon exits code=1 mid-drain + judge idle" flake. Commit c4ea7e02 on the attempt branch (daemon.js + bench/zonoid_bench/daemon.py).

FAILURE (1) — "daemon exits code=1 mid-drain" is NOT a crash. It is the Windows teardown artifact: daemon.py stop() called proc.terminate() (== TerminateProcess, hard kill, exit 1); the "[daemon.py] daemon pid=X exited with code=1" line is printed at stop() and stdout/stderr interleaving made it look mid-run. PROVEN alive throughout the drain: spawned Popen pid == daemon.pid pidfile, /health=ready, Popen.poll()=None until stop(). FIX (right layer = bench harness + daemon signal handler): daemon.js adds SIGBREAK to its existing SIGINT/SIGTERM graceful handler (releases ports, exit 0; no-op on POSIX); daemon.py start() spawns with CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP (Windows) and stop() sends CTRL_BREAK_EVENT first for a graceful exit 0, falling back to terminate()/kill() only on timeout. Teardown now logs "stopped, code=0 [graceful]". Verified: 3x start/stop cycles all code=0; full limit-1 run shows both embedded daemons "stopped, code=0 [graceful]", no spurious code=1.

FAILURE (2) — "judge idle, candidates=[]" is mostly honest retrieval variance, NOT a daemon bug. Reproduced both directions from the worktree: autowireNewTaskWholeGraph seeds only the top-5 PARENT notes (TASK_CREATE_FANOUT=5; source_chunks not seeded), and the only answer-bearing chunk (#chunk-7, "your dealership was able to resolve the issue with your GPS system", ~864 chars) is semantically distant from the question, so the GPS parent note is frequently displaced. The our-way-prod grader path (POST /subconscious/search-context, GRADER_MAX_ROUNDS=4) surfaces chunk-7 (cosine 0.439) ONLY when a round reformulates toward car/GPS terms. WHEN chunk-7 is retrieved the pipeline answers correctly: verified TWICE — grader.rounds=3 kept chunk-7, delivered_summary_len=864 GPS present, FINAL ANSWER "GPS system issue". Fixed the agentic search-context delivery clip. Commit 00806352 on the attempt branch (lib/search/context-compiler.js + lib/subconscious/index.js, +67/-1).

ROOT CAUSE: context delivered to the answerer was clipped to the 200-char display summary BEFORE reaching context_deps (memory-search.js slice(0,200) -> compactResult drops fields + reclips 240 -> contextDependencyFromResult slice(0,240) no-op). Source chunks hold the full answer in node.summary (CHUNK_CHARS=1200), so 200 chars truncated the GPS answer.

FIX (token-aware, agentic-path only): searchUrlForPlan sets full_content=1 (subconscious paths only; GET /search never sets it); compileSearchContext on that flag attaches bounded content (<=1200) from live node text, leaving the 200-char display summary untouched; compactResult preserves content; contextDependencyFromResult emits content as the delivered summary when present, else the prior 240 clip.

BEFORE/AFTER (direct HTTP repro vs WORKTREE daemon, head 00806352): POST /subconscious/search-context returned context_deps summary_len=1200 with the GPS answer text present (hasGPS=true); negative control GET /search stayed 200 with content_present=false (general consumers unaffected). arms.py agentic branch feeds the answerer from context_deps[].summary, now carrying the whole chunk.

BENCH CAVEAT (honest): full our-way-prod bench could NOT complete on this Windows box — across 3 runs the embedded daemon exited code=1 mid-run during the wiring judge-drain and the eager-judge ran IDLE (smoke A2 idle=True, candidates=[], context_deps=[]), so retrieval never reached the delivery layer (answer 'I don't know', grader:{}). Pre-existing environment instability independent of the fix; smoke RAG-control still scored token-F1=1.000, proving the search path is healthy/uncrashed. Smoke OVERALL=FAIL = documented judge_idle flake (A2) + downstream A1; A3 rigging guard PASSED; no new traceback.

ROOT CAUSE (as briefed): source_chunk knowledge nodes were lumped into the generic non-note task bucket and had to out-rank real tasks for the TASK_CREATE_FANOUT(=5) cut, so a semantically-distant evidence chunk (GPS chunk, cosine ~0.44) was only stochastically a Tier-1 candidate. Worst case +3 candidate edges per new task; off-topic tasks seed 0 (proven by unit test). Source-chunk autowire seeding lane added (daemon.js, commit 8e01166a, 25/25 tests pass). Seeds up to 3 source_chunks above a dedicated 0.30 cosine floor as weight-0 judged:false chunk->anchor candidates, excluded from the task bucket (worst case +3 edges/task; off-topic tasks seed 0). Seeding is now DETERMINISTIC (GPS chunk seeds at 0.413 across two ingests vs prior stochastic). PROVEN: seeded GPS candidate appears in /judge/next; after keepEdge promotion, /task/context returns the GPS chunk (w=0.413) + evidence text. But all 3 bench runs answered I-don't-know (0/3) DETERMINISTICALLY because the bench daemon has no judge backend (/judge/drain -> skipped:no_backend, no API key/unauthed CLI) so candidates never auto-promote, and our-way-prod's RAG search ranks the chunk at ~0.044 under probe-echoes at 1.2. Fix is correct + helps production daemons WITH a judge; remaining gap is judge availability + source_chunk ranking, outside autowire scope. See note note:note-mqsktjtz8ch.
